item.title: From the archives: Dolly Parton on the opening of Dollywood
item.description: In 1986 and 1988, legendary singer-songwriter Dolly Parton sat down with CBS News to discuss the opening of her Tennessee theme park, Dollywood, and what she hoped to accomplish with it. Parton's family announced her death on Tuesday.

item.title: Bureau of Prisons No. 2 official who was pardoned for drug crimes departs
item.description: Josh Smith had a tense relationship with BOP's employees, and some staffers had raised questions about contracts awarded during his year-long tenure.

item.title: Ontario's Doug Ford says Trump is "treating us like we're Communist China"
item.description: As a U.S.-Canada trade war sparks cross-border insults, Ontario Premier Doug Ford told CBS News he's hopeful the two sides can reach an agreement — but cautioned that "no deal is better than a bad deal."

item.title: Where things stand in South Carolina's Senate primary runoff between Graham, Norman
item.description: Darline Graham, the sister of the late Republican senator Lindsay Graham, is facing Rep. Ralph Norman in South Carolina's special primary runoff on Tuesday. CBS News' senior White House and political correspondent Ed O'Keefe reports.

item.title: Johnny Cash's son on his father's special relationship with Dolly Parton
item.description: Johnny Cash's son, John Carter Cash, and his wife, Ana Cash, join "The Daily Report" to discuss Johnny's close bond with Dolly Parton, who died Tuesday at the age of 80.

item.title: Doctor testifies Clancy was criminally responsible for killings as closing arguments approach
item.description: Forensic psychologist Dr. Kirk Heilbrun took the stand in Lindsay Clancy's trial for the killings of her three children on Tuesday, testifying that he felt Clancy was criminally liable despite claims of postpartum psychosis. CBS News' Shanelle Kaul has the details.

item.title: El-Sayed appears on Fox News for contentious interview
item.description: Michigan Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed joined Fox News's Jesse Watters on Monday night for a lively interview. Democratic strategist and CBS News political contributor Chuck Rocha joins with analysis.

item.title: Trump threatens to rename Lake Ontario as Canada announces retaliatory tariffs
item.description: President Trump threatened to rename Lake Ontario to Lake America on Tuesday as Canada announced retaliatory tariffs against the United States as the countries' trade war escalates. CBS News' Olivia Rinaldi has more.

item.title: Dolly Parton remembered by fellow stars, politicans: "A true loss for millions"
item.description: President Trump said that he would be "lowering the American flag" throughout the nation for one week in Dolly Parton's honor.

item.title: New study raises concerns about prevalence of CTE among NFL players
item.description: A new study is sounding the alarm about the prevalence of CTE in NFL players. According to the British Medical Journal, 1 in 4 players who died between 2016 and 2021 had the degenerative brain disease. Concussion & CTE Foundation CEO Chris Nowinski, whose organization helped conduct the study, joins to unpack the findings.

item.title: GOP Rep. Tom Barrett "still hopeful" U.S. and Canada can strike trade deal
item.description: The developing U.S.-Canada trade war is set to affect consumers nationwide, but may have an outsized impact on the economies of states along the northern border. Republican Rep. Tom Barrett of Michigan joins "The Takeout" to discuss this and his bill aimed at preventing federal "overreach" on data centers.

item.title: Ross Fire explodes to over 50,000 acres, forces evacuations in North Texas
item.description: The Ross wildfire has burned more than 50,000 acres across Palo Pinto and Jack counties, forcing evacuations, closing roads and disrupting schools.

item.title: Fans mourn loss of Dolly Parton as Trump orders flags flown at half-staff
item.description: Country music fans and fellow musical legends are mourning the loss of superstar Dolly Parton, whose death was announced Tuesday. CBS News' Nicole Valdes has more.

item.title: South Carolina GOP Senate primary runoff comes to a head
item.description: Republican voters in South Carolina are at the polls on Tuesday for the Senate primary runoff between Trump-backed Sen. Darline Graham and Rep. Ralph Norman. CBS News senior White House and political correspondent Ed O'Keefe reports.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy trial reaches final witness
item.description: Testimony in Lindsay Clancy's Massachusetts murder trial neared its end Tuesday as prosecutors called their final rebuttal witness.

item.title: Ontario Premier Doug Ford says "we just want a fair trade deal" as Canada announces tariffs on U.S.
item.description: Canada announced Tuesday tariffs of up to 50% on $20 billion in U.S. imports to match the Trump administration's recently announced tariffs. Is there an off-ramp for the trade battle? Ontario Premier Doug Ford joins "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: Pennsylvania records first 2 measles deaths in 35 years
item.description: Pennsylvania has recorded its first two deaths connected to measles in 35 years.

item.title: Dolly Parton, country music legend, dies at age 80
item.description: Dolly Parton became an icon over her six-decade career as a Grammy-winning singer-songwriter, movie and TV star and theme park owner who donated millions to help others.

item.title: Breaking down Canada's retaliatory tariffs against U.S.
item.description: Canada announced that it is imposing tariffs of up to 50% on about $20 billion of U.S. imports in an effort to match the Trump administration's newly announced levies on Canadian imports.. CBS News chief White House correspondent Nancy Cordes has the latest.

item.title: Dolly Parton's "9 to 5" and the U.S.-Canada trade battle
item.description: Dolly Parton, whose death was announced by her family on Tuesday, didn't write "9 to 5" as a meditation on trade policy, but the current trade battle between the Trump White House and Canada speaks to a theme in the hit song. Major Garrett explains. Then, CBS News' Anthony Mason joins to unpack Parton's legacy.

item.title: Survey pinpoints the behavior on planes that people find most annoying
item.description: Here's what travelers think about shared armrests, reclined seats and fellow passengers' use of tech on planes.

item.title: DOJ warns Kennedy Center could be knocked down if renovations don't move forward
item.description: The Trump administration said it may need to demolish the Kennedy Center if a plan to close the building for two years as part of a controversial renovation project pushed by President Trump and the organization's board is blocked.

item.title: The best of Dolly Parton with CBS News
item.description: Beloved country music legend Dolly Parton had died at age 80, her family announced on Tuesday. CBS News looks back at some of her best moments and interviews over the years.

item.title: Musk's SpaceX announces $100 billion plan for new spaceport in Louisiana
item.description: Elon Musk's space company plans to spend $100 billion to build a new spaceport in Louisiana to launch rockets, state officials and the company announced.

item.title: Dolly Parton: An extraordinary life in pictures
item.description: Dolly Parton, the country music legend who became a feminist icon, has died at the age of 80. Here is a look back at her life in pictures.

item.title: Rancher says Trump cutting tariffs on foreign beef could run him out of business
item.description: Cattle rancher Shawn Harris joins CBS News to discuss President Trump's decision to remove tariffs on 300,000 metric tons of ground beef for the next 90 days and its impact on American farmers.

item.title: Iran says it's ready for new U.S. sanctions, has 2-year plan
item.description: Iran's economy minister said the country has been preparing for a long time for the sanctions U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent described as the "greatest financial offensive" ever.

item.title: Canada announces tariffs of up to 50% on $20 billion in U.S. goods
item.description: Canadian government officials said they are also providing aid for workers and businesses that could be hurt by U.S.-imposed tariffs.

item.title: Black Hawk helicopter goes down in Colorado foothills in "aviation mishap"
item.description: A U.S. Army Black Hawk helicopter out of Fort Campbell in Kentucky made an apparently unplanned landing in a wooded area of the Colorado foothills west of Denver.

item.title: United Airlines to add 10 new international routes. See where.
item.description: The new overseas routes represent the largest expansion in the airline's history, United said.
